runtime_metric: GNN inference (logic AND device encoders), matching/repair/coordinates, initializer serialization/writing, plus VPR; excludes Python/Torch startup, model construction/loading and graph/device/metadata loading/transfer. Reusable RRG/graph preparation separately reported.
evaluation_role: Exploratory frozen-weight coverage sweep; seen and unseen families reported separately
timing_selection: Default-only reference width and highest frozen scan width; no GNN-success filtering

preparation_policy.selection: First Default-qualified grid on frozen width ladder; no GNN/final seeds
preparation_policy.reuse: Read-only exact source/BLIF/grid/seed/command outcomes; timeouts remain unknown
preparation_policy.graphs: Regenerate AP structure and all device IR/graphs after any grid change
